system.story: Disguise and social cover; the ghost with a face for every door.

description.value:
Method: Face-in-crowd. You disappear in plain sight.

Blend In

You can Fade via disguise or social cover, gain an edge to pass as someone you are not, and may drop an adjacent unaware foe and take their place.

Bonus skill and contact

You gain Deception or Disguise and a corp-insider or forger contact.

Pairs with

The Face (Commander) for espionage and heist work.
